;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Libyan Civil War (2014–present)|Second Libyan Civil War]], [[2019 Western Libya Offensive]]
**[[Libyan National Army]] troops reach the outskirts of the [[Libya]]n capital [[Tripoli, Libya|Tripoli]], securing a key military checkpoint known as "Bridge 27". [https://www.afp.com/en/news/15/pro-haftar-militia-forces-reach-outskirts-tripoli-doc-1fd5e05 (AFP)]
**The LNA captures several more towns in the [[Tripoli District, Libya|Tripoli District]], including [[Qasr bin Ghashir]], [[Wadi Rabie]] and [[Suq al-Khamis]], as well as the town of [[‘Aziziya]] in the [[Jafara|Jafara District]], to the west of Tripoli. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-libya-security-advance-idUSKCN1RH24V (Reuters)] [https://www.economist.com/middle-east-and-africa/2019/04/05/khalifa-haftar-libyas-strongest-warlord-makes-a-push-for-tripoli (''The Economist'')]
**LNA forces say they have seized control of [[Tripoli International Airport]]. [https://uk.reuters.com/article/uk-libya-security/east-libyan-troops-close-on-tripoli-alarming-u-n-idUKKCN1RH0SK (Reuters)]
**The [[United States]], [[United Kingdom]], [[France]], and [[Italy]] issue a joint statement calling on [[Field marshal (Libya)|Field Marshal]] [[Khalifa Haftar]] to end the offensive. [https://www.euronews.com/2019/04/04/tensions-flare-in-libya-as-eastern-libyan-commander-orders-forces-to-move-on-tripoli (Euronews)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Boeing 737 MAX groundings]], [[Ethiopian Airlines Flight 302]]
**The CEO for [[Boeing]], [[Dennis Muilenburg]], apologizes for the loss of lives in the two [[737 MAX]] accidents, recognizing the role that the [[MCAS (737)|MCAS]] system played in the disasters. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/2019/04/04/boeing-ceo-dennis-muilenburg-apologizes-lives-lost-ethiopian-indonesian-plane-crashes/ (''Washington Post'')]
*Nineteen people are killed after a vehicle lost control, skidded and then overturned in [[Faskari]], [[Katsina State]], [[Nigeria]]. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-04/06/c_137955086.htm (Xinhua)]
*Thirteen people are killed and four others are injured after a freight vehicle overturned in [[Sidama Region]], [[Ethiopia]]. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-04/06/c_137955515.htm (Xinhua)]

;Health and environment
*The U.S [[Centers for Disease Control and Prevention]] reports the source of [[Escherichia coli|E. coli]]  O103, that has infected 72 people in five states, has not been identified.  [[William Marler|Bill Marler]], a food safety lawyer in Seattle, notes this  O103 outbreak is by far the largest in recent memory. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/health/health-news/dozens-have-fallen-ill-during-a-five-state-e-coli-outbreak-and-nobody-knows-where-its-coming-from/ar-BBVFhpN?ocid=spartanntp (''The Washington Post'' via MSN.com)]

;Law and crime
*[[Julian Assange#Political asylum and life at the Ecuadorian embassy|Julian Assange's asylum at the Ecuadorian embassy]], [[INA Papers]]
**[[WikiLeaks]] says that a high-level source within the government of [[Ecuador]] has informed them that [[Julian Assange]] will be expelled within "hours to days" and that Ecuador's government already has an agreement with the UK for his arrest. On April 2, 2019, [[President of Ecuador|Ecuadorian President]] [[Lenín Moreno]] accused WikiLeaks of leaking the [[INA Papers]], a set of documents published in February 2019 which uncover the operations of [[INA Investment Corp]], an offshore [[tax haven]] created by the brother of President Moreno and allegedly reveal government corruption. [https://defend.wikileaks.org/2019/04/03/ecuador-twists-embarrassing-ina-papers-into-pretext-to-oust-assange/ (WikiLeaks)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/04/wikileaks-founder-assange-expelled-ecuador-embassy-190405030521011.html (Al Jazeera)]
*A 29-year-old man is charged with five counts of attempted murder after stabbing five people in "random attacks", including four people in a 10-hour period on March 30, in [[Edmonton, London]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-london-47823157 (BBC News)]
*An inquest finds that Jennifer and Sarah Hart intentionally killed themselves. In 2018, a vehicle with the couple and their six adopted children drove off a cliff in [[California]], killing all of them. [https://www.msn.com/en-ca/news/world/inquest-finds-the-hart-parents-intentionally-killed-their-6-adopted-kids-and-themselves/ar-BBVEzk4?ocid=spartanntp (MSN.com)]

;Science and technology
*A small 5-200 kilometer [[planetesimal]], with a similar mineral composition to Earth, is found orbiting in the [[debris disk]] of a white dwarf star. This discovery is among the first of its kind and expected to provide insight into the future of our own planetary system. [http://www.astronomy.com/news/2019/04/astronomers-discover-a-chunk-of-a-planets-core-around-dead-star (Astronomy.com)]
*[[JAXA]] space probe ''[[Hayabusa2]]'' successfully fires a bullet at [[Apollo asteroid]] [[162173 Ryugu]], forming a crater which will be used to collect underground samples. [https://apnews.com/2dd46c807e13486c9f658ec74776ce52 (AP)]
